title: Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Rubric Generation for Reliable Medical Response Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2601.15161v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for clinical decision support, where hallucinations and unsafe suggestions may pose direct risks to patient safety. These risks are hard to assess: subtle clinical errors are often missed by generic metrics and LLM judges using general criteria, while expert-authored fine-grained rubrics are expensive and difficult to scale. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-augmented multi-agent framework for automatically generating instance-specific evaluation rubrics.   Our approach grounds evaluation in authoritative medical evidence by decomposing retrieved content into atomic facts and synthesizing them with user interaction constraints to form fine-grained evaluation criteria. Evaluated on HealthBench and LLMEval-Med, our framework achieves Clinical Intent Alignment (CIA) scores of 50.20% and 31.90%, significantly outperforming the GPT-4o baseline and showing consistent improvements acros

translated_title: 基于检索增强的智能体评分标准生成，用于可靠的医疗响应评估
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于临床决策支持，其中幻觉和不安全的建议可能直接危及患者安全。这些风险难以评估：通用指标和使用一般标准的LLM评判者往往会忽略细微的临床错误，而专家撰写的细粒度评分标准成本高昂且难以规模化。在本文中，我们提出了一种检索增强的多智能体框架，用于自动生成针对具体实例的评估评分标准。我们的方法通过将检索到的内容分解为原子事实，并结合用户交互约束进行综合，形成细粒度的评估标准，从而使评估基于权威的医学证据。在HealthBench和LLMEval-Med上的评估中，我们的框架实现了50.20%和31.90%的临床意图对齐（CIA）分数，显著优于GPT-4o基线，并显示出跨多个方面的持续改进。
tldr: 本文提出了一种检索增强的多智能体框架，通过自动生成基于权威医学证据的实例特定评分标准，显著提升了医疗响应评估的可靠性和临床意图对齐度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented multi-agent framework that automatically generates instance-specific rubrics grounded in authoritative medical evidence, significantly improving the reliability and clinical intent alignment of medical response evaluation.
